description: Forward resolves an ENS name (vitalik.eth) to its address plus avatar, url and twitter records, or reverse resolves a 0x address to its verified primary ENS name. Reads Ethereum mainnet directly. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

name.description: ENS name such as vitalik.eth, or a 0x address for reverse lookup

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: ens_resolve
